description: Rooster and Rooster compatibility in the Chinese zodiac: the same animal, their Metal elements, yin-yang, and what helps the pairing.
answer: In Chinese astrology, two Roosters share the same branch, Metal element and Yin polarity, so the match is read as a mirror. Each recognises the other's precision, candour and diligence; the pairing tends to work best when the shared blind spot, the Rooster's critical streak, is named early.

sections.heading: How two Roosters relate
paragraphs: The Rooster tends to bring diligence, honesty and practical devotion to a relationship. It often keeps a shared life organised. On first meeting, the Rooster often comes across as confident, well-presented and candid. Traditional readings associate the Rooster with precision, candour and diligence, and in a same-animal pair that quality is present twice. What the Rooster tends to value most in a partner is honesty, punctuality and appreciation for effort. Crisp plans, sincere compliments and a tidy shared calendar usually delight a Rooster.

Two Roosters may have been born in the same year or twelve, twenty-four or more years apart, so their year elements can differ even though the animal is shared. The Rooster usually needs appreciation, order and a partner who values honesty and effort. Both partners usually need this at once, which can be a source of deep understanding or of competition for the same thing. Friends often notice that two Roosters share habits as well as values, from how they handle plans to how they greet strangers.

sections.heading: What the tradition says about a same-animal pair
paragraphs: When both partners are Roosters, the Chinese zodiac pairs an animal with itself. Classical tables do not list same-animal pairs among the harmonies or clashes; traditional readings instead describe them as mirrors, in which the Rooster's precision, candour and diligence is shared and so are its blind spots. Two Roosters often form an organised, hardworking and honest partnership with shared high standards. Plans tend to run smoothly. The risk is mutual criticism and competition over who is right. Pairs of Roosters tend to do best when they praise each other as readily as they correct.

Every Rooster shares the Metal trine with the Ox and Snake, has the Dragon as its Liu He secret friend, and sits opposite the Rabbit in the six clashes. Because the Rooster pairs with itself here, the Metal trine still frames the relationship: both partners share the same natural allies and the same opposite. In the traditional double-hour clock, the Rooster also names the hours from 5 pm to 7 pm.

sections.heading: Five elements and yin-yang
paragraphs: Two Roosters share Metal as their fixed element. In five-element thinking a shared element is read as mutual recognition, so each Rooster tends to understand the other's instincts, with the caution that the same strengths and excesses are doubled. As Yin animals, two Roosters share the same polarity, inward and receptive in traditional terms. In five-element terms the Rooster's Metal is associated with clarity and resolve, a quality two Roosters hold in common.

In everyday terms, the shared Metal of the Rooster and the Rooster suggests clarity, discipline and high standards on the Rooster's side and the Rooster's, which works well when criticism is balanced with warmth. Each birth year also carries its own element from the heavenly stems, so a Metal Rooster and a Water Rooster read slightly differently, and two Roosters born exactly twelve years apart will have year elements one step apart in the cycle. For example, the Rooster year of 2005 was a Wood year and the Rooster year of 2017 a Fire year, so two Roosters born in those years differ in flavour.

sections.heading: Friction and what helps two Roosters
paragraphs: Under stress, the Rooster can become critical, perfectionistic or defensive about its methods. When both partners respond this way at once, the pattern tends to amplify rather than balance out. After an argument, the Rooster usually wants the facts straightened out, and a Rooster who also acknowledges the Rooster's feelings helps it soften.

Between two Roosters, friction usually appears as mutual critique, each correcting the other's methods and standards. Pride can make apologies slow. Balancing every correction with a compliment, and choosing which battles truly matter, tends to keep two exacting minds affectionate.

What helps with a Rooster is acknowledging its effort, agreeing on standards in advance and offering feedback as kindly as it would like to receive it. For two Roosters, agreeing in advance who will step back first when the Rooster's critical streak appears can keep a shared trait from becoming a shared problem, and taking turns in that role keeps it fair.

sections.heading: Two Roosters day to day
paragraphs: At home, the Rooster tends to keep things organised and well presented, appreciating a Rooster who respects order and punctuality. Labelled drawers, a precise schedule and spotless surfaces often reveal a Rooster's influence. Two Roosters often run an immaculate household, punctual, tidy and beautifully presented. Standards are shared. Praising each other as readily as they critique keeps two perfectionists feeling appreciated rather than audited, and makes the polished life they build more enjoyable.

Traditionally the Rooster usually enjoys organised, polished outings such as well-planned trips, fine dining, fashion and early-morning activities, which two Roosters can enjoy side by side. As a colleague, the Rooster ensures quality and keeps schedules; beside the Rooster, it contributes precision and reliability. Audits, schedules and final checks are where the Rooster's precision is usually most prized. On a shared team, two Roosters tend to reinforce each other's precision, which is a real asset once roles are clearly divided.

faq.question: Are the Rooster and the Rooster compatible in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Classical tables do not rate same-animal pairs as harmonies or clashes. Two Roosters tend to understand each other quickly and share the same blind spot, the Rooster's critical streak, so awareness matters more than any rating.

faq.question: What are the elements of the Rooster?
faq.answer: The Rooster's fixed element is Metal and its polarity is Yin. Each birth year adds a separate year element from the heavenly stems.

faq.question: Which animals are best for the Rooster?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Ox and Snake share the Rooster's San He trine and the Dragon is its Liu He secret friend.

faq.question: What might the Rooster and the Rooster enjoy doing together?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rooster usually enjoys organised, polished outings such as well-planned trips, fine dining, fashion and early-morning activities. Two Roosters often enjoy these side by side, and taking turns to choose keeps plans fresh.

faq.question: Does the Chinese zodiac use the calendar year?
faq.answer: No. Animal years begin at Lunar New Year: the Rooster year of 2017 began on January 28, and the one before it, in 2005, on February 9, so January birthdays need checking. The calculator does this automatically.
